[b][color=#3c78d8][size=4][font=Verdana]Description, Requirements[/font][/size][/color][/b]
This is a bunch of seasonal portrets for Andy, so you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]SOSCA[/url]. Also can be used with alternative art mods, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482?tab=posts]Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime Portraits[/url].

[b][color=#3c78d8][size=4][font=Verdana]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install via mod manager[/*]
[*]Adjust dependencies - load this mod after all others[/*]
[*]Enjoy[/*]
[/list]If it does not work, you always can install portraits manually. Just replace original pngs in the dominant mod
